column1: # GE-T6's genre labels (SMYSL-2.6 §5.4), one per book of the 66-book canon, by USFM code.
# Read from §5.4's list: law (Exod-Deut), narrative (Gen, Josh-2 Kgs, Ruth, Esth, the Gospels,
# Acts), poetry (Job, Ps, Prov, Eccl, Song), prophecy (Isa-Mal, Rev), epistle (Rom-Jude). The
# list does not place 1-2 Chronicles, Ezra or Nehemiah; they are `-`, and the harness excludes
# and lists them rather than this file guessing. Labels are fixtures, reviewed once.
